name: flat-water-drain
comment: Water sources on the stone platform spread and settle into still water (BlockFlowing.updateFlow, BlockFlowing.java:14-19); a source pair at (-6,61,-6) and (-6,61,-4) makes the cell between them a source (two adjacent sources over a solid block, BlockFlowing.java:51-57). The centre source (0,61,0) is removed at t = 40 and (-6,61,-6) at t = 80 (set_block id 0): the still neighbours turn flowing (BlockStationary.setNotStationary, BlockStationary.java:23-30) and the levels decay to nothing (BlockFlowing.java:30-75), except around the remaining sources.
